subject: Private deployment: scheduling a network & operations walkthrough
messages:
From: Sam Keller <sam.keller@novacare.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@novacare.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T16:12:00-04:00
Subject: Private deployment - technical walkthrough request

Hi Jasmine and Markus,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The team at NovaCare wants to follow up with a focused walkthrough on our private deployment constraints (VPC peering options, on-prem gateway, and air-gapped transfer patterns). We want this to be a technical session with our infra and network folks so we can confirm feasibility and timeline.

Suggested goals for the call:
- Walk through the proposed network architecture (we've attached a rough sketch).
- Discuss network egress controls, proxying, and KMS/HSM integration options.
- Confirm what evidence you can provide for SOC/compliance reviewers.

Availability from our side next week (Eastern / ET):
- Tue 2026-08-17: 10:00–11:30 ET
- Wed 2026-08-18: 14:00–16:00 ET
- Fri 2026-08-20: 09:00–11:00 ET

Attendees on our side: Sam Keller (Infra), Lina Ortiz (Network Security), and our IT manager (ops@novacare.com) — I included Lina on this thread.

I've attached the quick sketch (novacare-network-sketch.pdf) for context. If you can confirm an internal Redwood list of attendees and whether you prefer a separate breakout for security/compliance questions, we'll book a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Sam

--
Sam Keller
Sr. Infrastructure Lead
NovaCare Health
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sam Keller <sam.keller@novacare.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T17:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment - technical walkthrough request

Hi Sam — great to hear from you and thanks for the sketch. We'll make this a targeted technical session. To make scheduling easier: we have two blocks that work well for our team (Pacific / PT):

- Wed 2026-08-18 09:00–10:30 PT (which is 12:00–13:30 ET)
- Thu 2026-08-19 11:00–12:30 PT (14:00–15:30 ET)

Proposed Redwood attendees:
- Jasmine Liu (Solutions) — I will run the session and own the agenda
- Markus Klein (Private Deployments lead) — architecture and network paths
- Ben Carter (On-prem ops) — packaging & install checklist
- Hannah Schmitt (Network ops) — connectivity and firewall guidance

Pre-reads we need from NovaCare: the current network diagram (full layer-3 details), egress policy draft, and the list of HSM/KMS providers you expect to use. If you can drop those into a shared Drive link, we'll put together a short checklist and agenda.

I'll tentatively hold the Wed slot on my calendar. If that works, I'll send a formal invite with the agenda and a short pre-read attached.

Best,
Jasmine

--
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Keller <sam.keller@novacare.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@novacare.com>, ops@novacare.com
Date: 2026-08-16T09:33:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment - technical walkthrough request

Jasmine — thanks, that helps. Quick notes:
- We have the full network diagram and will upload it to the Drive by EOD today.
- Wed 12:00–13:30 ET (your Wed slot) is good for Lina and me; Ops (ops@novacare.com) prefers mornings but can make this.
- Our environment: mixed US/EU datacenter footprint, will need to validate cross-region peering. Also important: our SOC team will expect a short appendix on data flows and retention controls.

If you can confirm the meeting duration (90 min ok?) and whether you want a short 15–20 min compliance breakout at the end, we'll finalize attendees.

Sam

--
Sam Keller
Sr. Infrastructure Lead
NovaCare Health
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Sam Keller <sam.keller@novacare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment - technical walkthrough request

Sam, Jasmine — 90 minutes works for us. One ask from my side: Ben and Hannah will want to run through the install surface and firewall rules, so could NovaCare share any existing ACL templates or egress IP ranges you currently permit? That will let us prepare the on-prem packaging checklist.

Also, heads up — if there are multiple datacenter locations (US + EU), we'll outline two routing patterns and a recommended fallback for cross-region peering during the session. Please add any regulatory constraints (e.g., EU data residency notes) to the Drive doc.

Markus

--
Markus Klein
Lead, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sam Keller <sam.keller@novacare.com>, Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@novacare.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Private deployment technical walkthrough — Wed 2026-08-18 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET

Thanks everyone — booking confirmed. Details below and a short agenda pasted after the calendar link.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-invite-id
Pre-reads: https://drive.google.com/open?id=example-pre-read (NovaCare will add the network diagram by EOD)
Attachments: redwood-private-onprem-checklist.xlsx; schedule-agenda.md

Agenda (90 min)
- 0–10 min: Introductions & objectives
- 10–35 min: NovaCare network topology walkthrough (Sam/Lina)
- 35–65 min: Redwood architecture & integration patterns (Markus/Ben)
- 65–80 min: Firewall/egress checklist & install considerations (Hannah/Ben)
- 80–90 min: Compliance appendix & next steps (Jasmine)

Action items before the call:
- NovaCare: upload full network diagram + list of egress IP ranges and any KMS/HSM vendors (Sam/Lina)
- Redwood: attach the on-prem checklist and quick install notes (I attached an initial draft).

If anything changes to attendees or timing, reply-all and we can adjust — appreciate the quick coordination.

See you Wed,
Jasmine

--
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123
